Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.
 
 People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values ; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.
 
 Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.
 
 Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!
 
 Job Description: 
 
 Microchip Technology Inc. has an opening for an Engineer I–Software Development position in Houston, Texas. In this role, the candidate will work as a C++ software developer in the L1 Quality Assurance (QA) team to enhance and maintain a custom framework for validating storage solutions in a fast paced, non-stop, automated test environment.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Help design, develop, and maintain an ever-expanding automation QA framework and suite of test cases and tools that use system-level and custom IOCTL calls to validate a complete data center storage solution

 Understand product implementation and expected product behaviors by reading specifications and source code

 Develop automated tests for validating new solutions and feature sets

 Improve the efficiency and capabilities of the QA automated test framework

 Work with QA and Development teams to debug and triage both test case and product failures

 Maintain servers and other hardware/software components used for continuous automated testing

 Work with QA and Development teams to track and provide estimates for tasks by utilizing and following the Agile methodology

 
 Requirements/Qualifications: 
 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering

 2+ years of proven programming experience using C++ and Bash Shell scripting

 Knowledge of Object-Oriented Design and programming best practices

 Strong analysis and debug skills

 Experience working in multi-threaded environments

 Strong verbal and written communication skills

 Experience working with Linux operating systems

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Able to apply memory management techniques in low-memory environments

 Familiarity with server storage technologies and concepts (RAID, SCSI, etc.)

 In addition to strong C++ coding experience, experience with Java, Python, and/or Perl is a plus

 
 
 
 
 
 Travel Time: 
 
0% - 25% 
 Physical Attributes: 
 
Feeling, Handling, Hearing, Reaching, Seeing, Talking, Works Around Others 
 Physical Requirements: 
 
Standing 10%, Walking 10%, Sitting 80%, Inside 100%, M-F 8-5pm 
 Microchip Technology Inc is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.
